response.rationale: The order status is "processing" and days_since_delivery is null, meaning the item has not yet been delivered. No window-based eligibility rule (RET-007) can be satisfied since it requires days_since_delivery <= 30, which cannot be evaluated as true when the value is null/undelivered. The item is not final sale (RET-012 inapplicable), not defective (RET-020 inapplicable), no goodwill grant (RET-050 inapplicable), and no fraud hold (RET-051 inapplicable). With no applicable eligibility rule satisfiable on the current facts, the return cannot be approved. Note: the customer's item is not yet delivered, so a return window has not opened; if delivery occurs, RET-007 could apply within 30 days.
